description: Search spreadsheet expenses by category, merchant, dates, amount or tags. When hasMore, reuse nextCursor with identical filters; avoid overlapping ranges. Optional query does deterministic non-embedding recall over merchant, city/location, Notes (e.g. receipt items, delivery source, payer or business purpose), Tag and category; ANDed with structured filters. Query examples: Tribeca restaurant, client dinner note. Results include matchedFields, matchReason and exact expenseId. expenseId is the exact durable Receipt ID for update_expense. paymentStatus is bookkeeping only, never bank settlement proof. For card/account nicknames use includePaidWith:true; page-only labels cannot filter all expenses. Country/client review: groupBy:country needs explicit YYYY-MM-DD bounds, at most 100 matches; narrow oversized ranges. Use configured travel categories; foreign locations do not prove travel. Keep unknown countries separate; ask about ambiguous places, never infer from currency. Country review allows categories/merchants/tags/countries/tagAssignment, no query or pagination. Show counts and per-currency totals; copy selectionItems (tag/date/location expectations) to group_expenses once a destination is chosen.

countries.description: Country-review filter: supported country names/codes, or unknown. Never infer a country from currency or an ambiguous city.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the previous search_expenses page. Reuse the same filters; never construct or edit this value.

dateRange.description: One period variant matching user wording.

groupBy.description: Read-only country review; requires explicit dateRange.start/end and at most 100 matches.

hasReceipt.description: When true, return only expenses with a receipt link. When false, return only expenses without one.

includePaidWith.description: Page labels only; unavailable differs from blank. No label filter.

paymentStatus.description: Bookkeeping prefix filter before pagination; not bank settlement. Ordinary search only.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword recall over the fields listed in the tool description; ANDed with structured filters.

tagAssignment.description: Country review: unassigned = blank/Business; no_client = no canonical client tag (incl. project/trip tags). Neither implies business use.

name: search_expenses

countryGroups.description: Complete bounded country review; unknown locations remain separate.

expenses.description: Matching expense rows, newest first, paginated.

amount.description: Amount in currency; country review uses original receipt currency.

expenseId.description: Durable Receipt ID (Column Q). The only identity accepted by update_expense.

nextCursor.description: Opaque signed continuation; reuse with identical filters.

total.description: Home-currency sum in normal search; null in country review. Use countryGroups totalsByCurrency, never sum currencies.
